_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: A voice cries out in the wilderness.
Prepare the way of the Lord.
Make the rough places a level road.
Every valley shall be lifted up.
One is coming whose sandal we cannot untie.
We wait for him in the wilderness.
Come, let us worship and ready the way.
Come, Lord Jesus. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Out in the wilderness a voice is crying — clear the road, fill the valleys, bring down the hills, and make a straight way home.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
Comfort, comfort my people, says your God; the warfare is ended, the long exile done.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
He will feed his flock like a shepherd, gather the lambs close, and carry the weary in his arms.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
So we step into the wilderness to wait, and we make the road ready for our God.
Come, Lord Jesus, come. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: A voice cries out across the wilderness.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
Make the road straight; fill every valley.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
The Shepherd gathers the lambs in his arms.
Come, Lord Jesus, come.
Come, let us worship and prepare the way.
Come, Lord Jesus, come. Amen.
